parts.name: Rotation
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotating metal cover of the USB flash drive, made of aluminum alloy for durability and protection.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the USB connector when not in use and can rotate around a pivot to expose or cover the connector.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a hinge axis, allowing 180° movement to open or close the USB connector.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the USB flash drive, made of ABS plastic, housing the electronic components and connector.
parts.Functional_description: It contains the memory chip and USB connector, providing the main structure and interface for data transfer.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the fixed base for the rotating cover.
